{{field-1}} $+C$"] [:db/add "d18d2d0d-fcf4-5a07-8a57-6df7fafbc007" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\sin{\left(2 x + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)}$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=2 \cos{\left(2 x + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)}.
$$

Substituting, including the required constant factor, gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{- 3 \cos{\left(2 x + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)}}{\sin{\left(2 x + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=- \frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
- \frac{3}{2}\left(\int \frac{1}{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{3}{2}\left(\ln\left|u\right|\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{3}{2}\left(\ln\left|\sin{\left(2 x + \frac{\pi}{6} \right)}\right|\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "d18d2d0d-fcf4-5a07-8a57-6df7fafbc007" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "d18d2d0d-fcf4-5a07-8a57-6df7fafbc007" :question/answer-fields "d3c656a2-a96b-50c8-930c-79df5dc92847"] [:db/ensure "d18d2d0d-fcf4-5a07-8a57-6df7fafbc007" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068918 :knowledge-point/questions "d18d2d0d-fcf4-5a07-8a57-6df7fafbc007"] [:db/add "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a" :answer/id #uuid "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a"] [:db/add "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a" :answer/value "- \frac{6}{5}\left(\ln\left|\sin{\left(5 x \right)}\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/id #uuid "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21"] [:db/add "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/choices "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a"] [:db/add "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/correct "1781e2dd-9f8d-516f-8851-d2ce8c04531a"] [:db/ensure "a684ef73-2cee-5b36-8f8b-9f7e97862a21" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "85f9dec2-2bed-5b96-9584-ac2b0b6c1efc" :question/id #uuid "85f9dec2-2bed-5b96-9584-ac2b0b6c1efc"] [:db/add "85f9dec2-2bed-5b96-9584-ac2b0b6c1efc" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.
